correctness.rationale: The incidence identity NN^T=qI+J implies precisely four Laplacian eigenvalues and gives the necessary-and-sufficient PBH coordinate matrix R_S, including both repeated eigenspaces and both simple modes. All-but-one point selection attains the v-1 dimension lower bound for every existing plane. At order two, 3003 cases are exhaustively enumerated over F101, and the integer Hadamard bound <101 makes every modular determinant decision exact; the full 336 graph automorphisms and fourteen orbits are computed explicitly. Independent all-case Krylov rank tests over F1009 agree; there is no unproved extrapolation from finite data.

value.rationale: Independent actuator selection on incidence networks is a natural network-control design problem. The all-order geometric determinant criterion and complete finite-Heawood minimum-placement census distinguish 1890 genuinely feasible labeled designs into 14 symmetry classes, supplying exact canonical finite-network data beyond a generic multiplicity bound. No downstream or energy claim is required; the discrete optimal-placement classification is the intrinsic mathematical contribution.
